authored_narrative.episode_purpose: Sixteen real episodes on, the guest hall and the tunnel threshold — two spaces that once carried real weight in this Story's first act — appear together once more, fully absorbed into the ordinary texture of a life these two now simply live.

scene_spirited_away_guest_hall_0078.purpose: The guest hall that once closed Episode 1's arc with earned significance now closes nothing — it's simply a room they pass through, its grandeur no longer needing acknowledgment.
scene_spirited_away_guest_hall_0078.stakes: whether a space this Story once treated as meaningful can recur without demanding meaning again
scene_spirited_away_guest_hall_0078.opposing_force: none — the scene deliberately withholds any

scene_spirited_away_tunnel_threshold_008.purpose: A tunnel threshold, the shape of every crossing this Story has ever tracked, appears with no crossing-related weight at all — a passage, not a threshold, in every sense that matters now.

shot_spirited_00617.intent: A wide, unemphatic shot of the hall, scale acknowledged and immediately moved past.

shot_spirited_00649.intent: A brief transitional frame, no threshold-coded composition at all — just movement from one space to the next.
